subject: Docker blip at ~17:30: dockerd (which I had restarted after the 15:28 reboot) was stopped by my session's time limit; I restarted it detached and 'docker start'ed every container that had been running. Check your stack if a run failed around then.
body: All pg-/storage-/mail-/auth-/proxy containers that exited at that moment were started again in dependency order (pg first). pg-seg02 was already exited 2 h earlier and was left alone. dockerd now runs detached from any agent session.
